messages:
Anna: MiraHealth returned the vendor security questionnaire. They want deletion timelines for hosted/dedicated and ask if we can provide a signed attestation confirming backup deletion on request. Need reply by EOD tomorrow.

Leah: Infra summary: Hosted: primary data removed within 24h after validated request. Backups deleted per retention policy, removed within 30 days. Deletion events logged in tenant audit logs. Dedicated/Private: we run a coordinated purge using our deletion runbook; customers with CMKs can disable keys to render data inaccessible and we can produce confirmation artifacts.

Mike: Recommend we avoid absolute wording about backups. Add that operational logs are redacted/hashed for PII and deletion actions produce audit entries. Legal must sign any attestation.

sara_legal: I can draft a limited attestation. Will state we will execute the deletion process and provide evidence (audit logs, runbook steps) but will not claim absolute destruction of all backup copies globally. Ill post a short signed statement here by COB.

Julian: Ill send the infra blurb + DPA/SOC2 summary to MiraHealth and flag renewal risk as medium until we have the attestation. If legal approves wording, will attach signed note.

OnboardingBot: Uploaded "mira_deletion_attestation_draft.pdf" to thread.

Anna: Thanks team. Please paste final signed language here so I can close the loop with the customer and remove the renewal flag.
